templates.preop_preparation:
1. Fasting for at least 12 hours before surgery, water ad libitum.
2. Animals are sedated with Azaperonum (40 mg/mL) 3-5 mg/kg and Atropine (1 mg/mL) 0.03-0.05 mg/kg IM. Monitor respiratory rate closely.
3. After 20-30 mins, induce anesthesia with Zoletil-50 4.4 mg/kg IM.
4. After 5-10 mins, move animal to surgery table, perform endotracheal intubation in prone position, connect to gas anesthesia machine (Isoflurane 0.5-2% in 2-3 L/min O2). Monitor anesthesia depth.
5. Pre-operative preparation: Move animal to table, prone intubation, clipping hairs, connect anesthesia machine.
6. Pre-op IM antibiotics Cefazolin 15 mg/kg and analgesic Meloxicam 0.4 mg/kg.
Follow SOP TU-03-09-00.

templates.monitoring:
Adjust oxygen flow and anesthetic gas concentration based on anesthesia depth, respiration, and surgical needs. Maintain body temperature and monitor heart rate, respiration, and temperature using a physiological monitor, recording every 30 minutes.
Perform according to 'TU-03-09-00 Standard Operating Procedure for Experimental Pig Surgery'.

defaults.preop_Preparation:
1. Experimental animals fast for at least 12 hours before surgery, with no water restriction.
2. The test pigs are washed and dried, then sedated with Azaperonum (40 mg/mL) 3-5 mg/kg and Atropine (1 mg/mL) 0.03-0.05 mg/kg by intramuscular injection. Carefully observe the respiratory rate of the pigs.
3. After 20-30 minutes, anesthesia is induced by intramuscular injection of Zoletil®-50 at 4.4 mg/kg.
4. After 5-10 minutes, move the pig to the operating table, perform tracheal intubation in a prone position, and connect to a gas anesthesia machine. Maintain anesthesia with oxygen at a flow rate of 2-3 L/min mixed with 0.5-2% gas anesthetic Isoflurane, always paying attention to the anesthesia depth of the pig.
5. Pre-operative intramuscular injection of antibiotic Cefazolin 15 mg/kg and analgesic meloxicam 0.4 mg/kg.
Follow the 'TU-03-09-00 Experimental Pig Surgical Standard Operating Procedure'.

stops.title: Welcome to iPig System
body: An integrated platform for managing research mini-pigs — covering the full lifecycle from "experiment application → committee review → daily care → pathology records → final report" with end-to-end traceability.
The system is GLP- and 21 CFR §11-compliant for electronic records — every write is captured in a complete audit trail.
Guest mode is fully read-only — you can navigate any page and open any document, but Save buttons will not persist data.

stops.title: Stop 1: Animal Use Protocols (the timeline starts here)
body: Before any animal experiment, the researcher must submit an IACUC Animal Use Protocol (AUP). Full timeline:
① Draft (DRAFT) → ② Submit (SUBMITTED) → ③ Committee review 4-6 weeks → ④ Approved (APPROVED) → ⑤ Animals enter facility → ⑥ Experiment execution
Example "AUP-2025-001 Cardiovascular Drug Safety": draft 2025-09-15 → submitted 09-20 → approved 11-01 → D-001/D-002 entered 11-15 → experiment started 2026-01-05.
stops.cta: Open AUP-2025-001 to see full content

stops.title: Stop 2: Protocol authoring flow
body: When creating a new protocol, the system splits the form into 10 sections (basic info, research purpose, animal source, anesthesia, surgery, …) — you can switch freely.
The "next unfilled field" button on the left guides you to fill in order, avoiding omissions.
Every field is validated by a Zod schema plus an AI pre-review (consistency + completeness checks).

stops.title: Stop 3: Animal management (the timeline in concrete form)
body: Each pig has its own medical chart: ear tag, breed, birth date, entry date/weight, source, weight curve, vaccination/deworming, pathology records.
Example D-001: female (5 months old) from "Civilian Pig Farm A", entered 2025-11-15 at 22 kg → quarantine vaccination (11-20 ~ 12-05) → entered experiment 2026-01-05 → left-eye surgery 01-15.
The 5 demo animals span three states: in-experiment (D-001/D-002/D-005) / unassigned (D-003, just entered) / completed (D-004, prior protocol closed).
stops.cta: Open D-001 to see the full timeline

stops.title: Stop 4: Surgery records and pain assessment
body: Surgery records cover pre-op anesthesia, intra-op physiological monitoring (HR / RR / temp / SpO₂ logged every 15 min), and post-op medication.
Post-op pain assessment scores 6 dimensions daily (wound, attitude, appetite, defecation, urination, pain) with a total score tracking recovery.
Example D-001 left-eye surgery: from mild pain (total 3) on day 1 to fully recovered (total 0) on day 3 — illustrating care quality.

stops.title: Stop 5: PDF reports (GLP documents)
body: 5 official GLP documents are built in (AUP protocol, medical record summary, surgery record, review result, review reply form).
All PDFs are rendered from docx templates via Microsoft Word COM — pixel-equivalent to the paper templates (including KaiTi font / official letter formatting).
Each generated PDF is written to the `pdf_artifacts` table with a SHA-256 hash + HMAC chain for permanent evidentiary record.

stops.title: Stop 6: Audit trail (the GLP value proposition)
body: Every write is recorded in the activity log: who, when, what changed, from which IP / which browser.
Records are chained one-way with HMAC-SHA256 (each entry's hash includes the previous one), so any tampering is detected immediately.
Sample logs cover the full event-type spectrum: login, weight entry, vet recommendation, surgery creation, protocol submission, protocol approval, login failure (suspected attack), and more.

stops.title: Stop 7: QAU (Quality Assurance Unit)
body: QAU is an independent audit subsystem: scheduled inspections, non-conformance tracking, SOP document control, audit scheduling.
Sample inspections cover three categories — protocols, facilities, equipment. NCs (Non-Conformances) track the full lifecycle from issuance to closure.
SOP documents are version-controlled with effective_date / review_date auto-reminders, preventing the use of expired SOPs.

stops.title: Tour complete 🎉
body: You've seen the 7 core features of iPig System. Suggested next areas to explore:
• My Protocols (PI view)  • Facility management (building / zone / pen 3-tier hierarchy)  • ERP warehouse inventory
If you want to try real operations, please contact the administrator to issue a trial account (in guest mode all writes are blocked).
